| base report source d calls result snapshot |
base := '/opt/git/BenjaVisionPro/catalyst-workspace/Magritte/magritte-cpp/conformance/'.
report := [ CCNativeMcpLease forRunningServers during: [
source := MADynamicOptions block: [ :query | { query } ].
calls := OrderedCollection new.
source includesBlock: [ :value | calls add: value. value = 'known' ].
snapshot := [ :value | value isNil ifTrue: [ 'nil' ] ifFalse: [ value class = MADynamicOptions ifTrue: [ value == source ifTrue: [ 'source' ] ifFalse: [ 'copy' ] ] ifFalse: [ value asString ] ] ].
{ MASingleOptionDescription. MAMultipleOptionDescription } flatCollect: [ :cls |
 { false. true } flatCollect: [ :ext |
 { false. true } flatCollect: [ :sorted |
  { false. true } flatCollect: [ :required |
   { nil. 'known'. 'new' } collect: [ :current |
    d := cls new options: source; extensible: ext; sorted: sorted; required: required; reference: MAStringDescription new; yourself.
    calls removeAll.
    result := [ (d allOptionsWith: current) collect: snapshot ] on: Error do: [ :error | { error class name asString. (error respondsTo: #message) ifTrue: [ error message selector asString ] ifFalse: [ '' ] } ].
    Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> cls name asString. 'extensible' -> ext. 'sorted' -> sorted. 'required' -> required. 'current' -> (snapshot value: current). 'result' -> result asArray. 'calls' -> calls asArray } ] ] ] ] ]
] ] ensure: [ (base , 'dynamic-options-probe-mcp-gate.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: '{"complete":true,"nativeResources":false}' ] ].
'/private/tmp/magritte-dynamic-options-probe.json' asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: (NeoJSONWriter toStringPretty: report) ].

reference.code:
| base report source calls queryCalls readers d ref encode codeOf rows configs candidates validations describeResult prep current info copied originalCopy staticCases dynamicCases binding metadata textual errors state sourceBefore |
base := '/opt/git/BenjaVisionPro/catalyst-workspace/Magritte/magritte-cpp/conformance/'.
report := [ CCNativeMcpLease forRunningServers during: [
calls := OrderedCollection new.
queryCalls := OrderedCollection new.
readers := OrderedCollection new.
state := OrderedCollection withAll: #('alpha' 'alpine' 'beta' 'Alpha').
encode := [ :v |
 v isNil ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'nil' } ] ifFalse: [
 v isCharacter ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'character'. 'value' -> v asString } ] ifFalse: [ v isString ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'string'. 'value' -> v } ] ifFalse: [
 v isInteger ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'integer'. 'value' -> v asString } ] ifFalse: [
 v isArray ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'array'. 'value' -> (v collect: encode) } ] ifFalse: [
 (v == true or: [ v == false ]) ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'boolean'. 'value' -> v } ] ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported reference value' ] ] ] ] ] ] ].
source := MADynamicOptions block: [ :query | queryCalls add: query. (state select: [ :s | s beginsWith: query ]) asArray ].
source includesBlock: [ :value | calls add: (encode value: value). value = 'member' or: [ value = 42 ] ].
ref := MANumberDescription new accessor: (MADictionaryAccessor key: #reference); label: 'Reference'; min: 10; max: 20; yourself.
d := MASingleOptionDescription new accessor: (MADictionaryAccessor key: #choice); label: 'Choice'; reference: ref; options: source; yourself.
dynamicCases := OrderedCollection new.
#('al' 'Al' '' 'z') do: [ :query |
 dynamicCases add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'query' -> query. 'value' -> (encode value: (d allOptions maSelectMatching: query)) }) ].
state add: 'altar'.
dynamicCases add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'query' -> 'al'. 'value' -> (encode value: (d allOptions maSelectMatching: 'al')) }).
readers add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'case' -> 'identity'. 'input' -> (encode value: 'alpine'). 'value' -> (encode value: (source detect: 'alpine')) }).
source reader: [ :value | value asUppercase ].
readers add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'case' -> 'reader'. 'input' -> (encode value: 'alpine'). 'value' -> (encode value: (source detect: 'alpine')) }).
copied := d copy.
originalCopy := source copy.
source reader: [ :value | 'new-', value ].
readers add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'case' -> 'descriptionCopy'. 'input' -> (encode value: 'alpine'). 'value' -> (encode value: (copied allOptions detect: 'alpine')) }).
readers add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'case' -> 'sourceChanged'. 'input' -> (encode value: 'alpine'). 'value' -> (encode value: (source detect: 'alpine')) }).
info := Dictionary newFrom: { 'allOptionsSame' -> (d allOptions == source). 'rawSame' -> (d options == source). 'copySame' -> (copied options == source). 'copyReferenceSame' -> (copied reference == d reference). 'sourceCopySame' -> (originalCopy == source). 'completionBlockShared' -> (originalCopy block == source block). 'membershipBlockShared' -> (originalCopy includesBlock == source includesBlock). 'readerSlotIndependent' -> (originalCopy reader == source reader) not }.
rows := OrderedCollection new.
{ MASingleOptionDescription. MAMultipleOptionDescription } do: [ :cls |
 { false. true } do: [ :required |
  { false. true } do: [ :extensible |
   { false. true } do: [ :sorted |
    d := cls new accessor: (MADictionaryAccessor key: #choice); label: 'Choice'; reference: ref; options: source; required: required; extensible: extensible; sorted: sorted; yourself.
    queryCalls removeAll. calls removeAll.
    prep := d allOptions.
    rows add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> cls name asString. 'required' -> required. 'extensible' -> extensible. 'sorted' -> sorted. 'same' -> (prep == source). 'queries' -> queryCalls asArray. 'includes' -> calls asArray }) ] ] ] ].
validations := OrderedCollection new.
{ MASingleOptionDescription. MAMultipleOptionDescription } do: [ :cls |
 { false. true } do: [ :required |
  { false. true } do: [ :extensible |
   { nil. 'member'. 42. 15. 5. 'other'. #('member' 42). #('other' 5). #(). 'AB' } do: [ :candidate |
    d := cls new accessor: (MADictionaryAccessor key: #choice); label: 'Choice'; reference: ref; options: source; required: required; extensible: extensible; yourself.
    queryCalls removeAll. calls removeAll.
    codeOf := [ :error | (error isKindOf: MAMultipleErrors)
     ifTrue: [ error collection flatCollect: codeOf ]
     ifFalse: [ { Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> error class name asString. 'description' -> error tag label } } ] ].
    errors := [ d validate: candidate. #() ] on: MAValidationError do: [ :e | codeOf value: e ].
    validations add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> cls name asString. 'required' -> required. 'extensible' -> extensible. 'input' -> (encode value: candidate). 'errors' -> errors asArray. 'queries' -> queryCalls asArray. 'includes' -> calls asArray }) ] ] ] ].
d := MASingleOptionDescription new accessor: (MADictionaryAccessor key: #choice); label: 'Choice'; reference: MAStringDescription new; options: source; yourself.
textual := Dictionary new.
textual at: 'readError' put: ([ d optionsTextual. 'none' ] on: Error do: [ :e | e class name asString ]).
d optionsTextual: 'first', String cr, 'second'.
textual at: 'after' put: (encode value: d options asArray); at: 'providerReplaced' put: d options isCollection.
staticCases := #('al' 'Al' '') collect: [ :query | Dictionary newFrom: { 'query' -> query. 'value' -> (encode value: (#('alpha' 'alpine' 'beta' 'Alpha') select: [ :s | s beginsWith: query ])). 'liveError' -> ([ #('alpha' 'alpine' 'beta' 'Alpha') maSelectMatching: query. 'none' ] on: Error do: [ :e | e class name asString ]) } ].
Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> (Dictionary newFrom: { 'name' -> MADynamicOptions name asString. 'superclass' -> MADynamicOptions superclass name asString. 'abstract' -> MADynamicOptions isAbstract. 'label' -> MADynamicOptions label }).
 'queries' -> dynamicCases asArray. 'readers' -> readers asArray. 'identity' -> info. 'allOptions' -> rows asArray. 'validation' -> validations asArray. 'textual' -> textual. 'staticMatching' -> staticCases asArray.
 'allOptionsWith' -> (NeoJSONReader fromString: '/private/tmp/magritte-dynamic-options-probe.json' asFileReference contents).
 'policy' -> 'Real MADynamicOptions objects, callbacks and description copies in live GT. No enumeration by allOptions, validation or copying. Kernel Object>>asArray wraps a copied provider for allOptionsWith; copyWith: is unsupported. Values and errors are projected to the existing portable value and flattened validation profiles. Live Collection>>maSelectMatching: calls an unavailable startsWith: selector; its source-directed prefix behavior is checked using actual String>>beginsWith: and the live failure remains recorded.' }
] ] ensure: [ (base , 'dynamic-options-mcp-gate.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: '{"complete":true,"nativeResources":false}' ] ].
(base , 'dynamic-options-reference.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: (NeoJSONWriter toStringPretty: report) ].
{ (report at: 'validation') size. (report at: 'allOptions') size }
